This is a sound-only loop. There are no player keys or changing game graphics. The one-line BASIC source repeatedly writes 23 and 7 to port 254; it loops forever until interrupted.

Fuse 48K at 400% speed: wait 4 seconds for tape loading, press Return for 0.04 seconds, wait 0.7 seconds, press R for RUN and press Return, each held 0.04 seconds, wait 0.6 seconds and capture the blank running screen. Wait a further 6 seconds and capture another view. Replays end by closing the emulator, not by reaching a BASIC STOP statement.
